title: Giotto object manifest
description: Machine-readable inventory of a giotto object, emitted by GiottoClass::objManifest_json(). Derived from the object on demand, never stored on it. Companion document: history.ndjson, one operation per line, from objHistory_ndjson().

generated_by.description: Package and version that wrote this document.

uid.description: Minted once at object creation and carried through renames, copies and save/load. Null for objects created before uids existed.

versions.description: Contents of the object's versions slot, as strings.

summary.description: Read first. Everything under slots is the detail this indexes.

slots.description: One entry per non-empty giotto slot, nested exactly as the object nests it (spat_unit, feat_type, name, and any intermediate key such as dim_type or nn_type). Keys are emitted in sorted order so the document is canonical and diffs are stable.

warnings.description: Dotted paths of fields that could not be READ (an accessor errored). A field that reads cleanly and is simply absent is omitted rather than listed here.

node.description: Either a described leaf or another level of nesting.

leaf.description: One subobject. Fields beyond class are class-specific and are omitted when not applicable.

shape.description: [rows, cols]. For expression this is [features, cells].

columns.description: Column names, or per-column descriptions with distinct-value counts for metadata.

n_records.description: giottoBinPoints: one record per (bin, feature) detection.

compact.description: giottoBinPoints: whether the counts table is in its compacted form.

n.description: Count of ids, for the cell_ID and feat_ID slots. The ids themselves are never emitted.

fingerprint.description: xxhash64 of a canonical reduced representation of the content: dimensions, dimnames, and a fixed-stride slice of the values (all values when fingerprint = 'full'). Deterministic and RNG-free. Numbers are compared to 12 significant digits and geometry coordinates as an ordered multiset, so the fingerprint identifies values rather than a particular serialization of them; a difference below roughly 1e-12 relative is not distinguished. Absent when fingerprinting was not requested, {digest} is unavailable, or the representation would have to be materialised from disk to hash.

x-encoding-rules.special-values: NA, NaN, Inf and -Inf are encoded as the strings "NA", "NaN", "Inf" and "-Inf", never as JSON null. A JSON null means the field was absent, which is a different fact.
x-encoding-rules.key-order: Object keys are emitted in sorted order at every level so two manifests of the same state serialize identically.

x-alabaster-alignment.intent: Slot vocabulary is close enough to takane/alabaster that a GiottoDisk<->alabaster bridge and cross-language readers should be cheap to add later. expression maps to assays, cell_metadata to column_data, feat_metadata to row_data, dimension_reduction to reduced_dimensions, spatial_locs to the spatial coordinates of a SpatialExperiment. The Giotto-specific spat_unit x feat_type nesting has no takane equivalent and would become one takane object per (spat_unit, feat_type) pair.
